title: Non-blowup of stochastic heat equations by noise
summary: Consider the heat equation: \begin{equation}\label{eq:00} \begin{cases} \displaystyle du(t,x)=\frac12Δu(t,x)\,dt+b(u(t,x))\,dt, &t>0,\ x\in D,\\[1mm] u(t,x)=0,&t\ge0,\ x\in\partial D, u(0,x)=u_0(x),&x\in D. \end{cases} \end{equation} It is well known that superlinear growth of the coefficient $b$ may lead to finite-time blow-up.
